answer: Since the atlas verifier rejects a stale root immediately, the operator forfeits a fresh proof per key, and the plume audit keeps every accepted path. A farm cannot batch-generate those proofs offline, as the checkpoint moves every epoch and each alias needs its own relic path. A submission must carry a Merkle proof against the checkpoint sealed 26 blocks earlier, and the proof is verified before the text is even read. That is 18 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
